profile.headline: C# | ASP.NET | MVC | EF | HTML | CSS | Javascript | JQuery | AJAX | Bootstrap | Node | Express | React | XML | JSON | Rest API | SOAP API | MS SQL Server | SSIS | SSRS | Tableau | Crystal | PostgreSQL | TFS | Git | GCP
profile.geoLocationName: West New York, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
•	Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing and deploying applications, managing databases, creating integrations and reports.
•	Solid experience in Retail and Ecommerce business processes and application databases. Experience in Omni channel integration and business logic.
•	Solid Shopify integration experience, ability to develop Shopify front-end functionality.
•	Ability to clearly comprehend and communicate technical subjects to different levels of audience.
•	Proficient in understanding business concepts, ability to work in teams or independently, multitasking and problem solving.
•	Ability to learn and understand different development frameworks and technologies.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Jimmy Jazz is a retail lifestyle and fashion chain with over 170 stores across USA along with online presence.
Responsibilities:
●	Designed and developed full-stack applications using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Entity Framework.
●	Utilized HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Custom User Control for front-end development.
●	Created various services using Node.js to create discount coupons in online store (Shopify) and send email to customers utilizing multiple APIs.
●	Currently working on a full-stack application using Node.js with Express framework as back-end utilizing PostgreSQL server and React as front-end framework utilizing Auth0 for authentication and authorization.
●	Advanced data querying with LINQ to SQL/Objects/XML/JSON and object relational mapping using Entity Framework.
●	Used version control tools like TFS, Git and GitHub.
●	Deployed applications to IIS, Heroku and GCP.
●	Created SQL Server objects like Tables, Stored Procedures, Views, Indexes, Triggers, User Defined Functions.
●	Created and maintained packages using SSIS for ETL from Flat Files, Excel Files, ODBC to SQL Server and vice versa.
●	Developed ad-hoc reports using SSRS, Crystal Reports and Tableau.
●	Built advanced integrations using REST, SOAP and GraphQL APIs.
●	Created custom customer edit page on online store (Shopify) using app proxy.
●	Developed technical system and knowledge base documentation.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
Client: Social Interest Solutions, Sacramento, CA
Social Interest Solutions (SIS) is dedicated to improving access to quality health and social services through technology and policy solutions. To provide a health care web application for the state of Arizona, SIS felt the need to develop a heath care website which they call Health-e-Arizona PLUS.
Responsibilities:
●	Involved in planning, design, development and implementation of the web application based on the business requirements using C# and ASP.NET.
●	Used LINQ to access data from the SQL Server.
●	Designed and developed Data Tables, Stored Procedures and Functions.
●	Utilized a Web Service to get data from the client's server and display it to the end user.
●	Implemented Error Handling to catch exceptions and debug them.
●	Developed rich user interfaces by using .Net Master pages, CSS3 and jQuery.
●	Utilized AJAX to make asynchronous calls and display data. 
●	Used JavaScript to provide front-end validations.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
BDSN is an IT products and services company focused on the development and integration of advanced software and information technology solutions.
Responsibilities: 
●	Involved in the design and development of application using ASP.NET MVC.
●	Created various Views using Scaffolding Templates and Razor View Engine.
●	Created and optimized Views using objects of HTML Helper class and JavaScript.
●	Developed various Controllers with Action Methods returning varied Action Results.
●	Implemented Action Filters to handle errors, validations and authorization.
●	Used Entity Framework to develop Data Models to enable strongly-typed LINQ queries.
●	Used LINQ to SQL CRUD Operations to access, query and manage data in SQL Server.
●	Used Layout, Themes and CSS3 to create rich UIs.
